bibl.title: Apostrophes between Double Consonants before the Third Century CE
bibl.seg: Nicholas E. Wagner, Apostrophes between Double Consonants before the Third Century CE.
bibl.note: Aims to reevaluate the evidence for the use of the apostrophe to separate double consonants before the third century CE, by offering an overview of the papyri which possibly attest this practice before this date and discussing in detail each case.
